Who I am

About Me

I'm Santhosh — a Mechanical Engineering student from Nellore, Andhra Pradesh, with a mind that's always been drawn to speed. Growing up watching Formula 1 wasn't just a hobby; it was the reason I chose engineering. Every race lap, every strategy call, every tenth of a second shaved off — that world is where I want to work.

I'm someone who connects deeply with the precision that motorsport demands. Whether it's staying up to study WEC race strategies or spending hours understanding why a car's balance shifts mid-stint, I'm driven by genuine curiosity — not just coursework. I bring that same obsessiveness to everything I build and analyse.

Outside the technical side, I follow racing across all categories — F1, WEC, Formula E — and I write about it too. My long-term goal is to work in a professional motorsport environment, contributing to the engineering decisions that happen at the sharp end of the grid.

Selected Work

Featured Projects

Machine Learning · Formula 1

Tyre Degradation Prediction & Lap Time Estimation Using ML

Developed a comprehensive ML pipeline using Belgian Grand Prix telemetry data. Trained a Random Forest Regressor (200 estimators) on tyre life, compound type, and sector times. Significantly outperforms the physics-based linear degradation model across MAE, RMSE and R².

Telemetry · MoTeC i2 · Sim Racing

Sim Racing Telemetry Analysis

Collected and analysed telemetry data from Assetto Corsa Competizione using MoTeC i2. Evaluated braking points, throttle application, steering inputs, and sector times to identify performance improvements — mirroring professional motorsport workflows.

MoTeC i2 Assetto Corsa Telemetry Lap Analysis
FEA · Structural Analysis · ANSYS

SAE Baja Chassis Crash Test & Safety Analysis

Performed non-linear dynamic FEA crash simulations using ANSYS Mechanical to validate driver safety and meet SAE impact standards. Analysed stress concentration, energy absorption, and structural deformation in the roll cage.

ANSYS Mechanical FEA Crash Simulation SAE Standards
Deep Learning · Predictive Maintenance

Fault Diagnosis of Impeller Using CNN

CNN-based binary classifier detecting defective vs non-defective submersible pump impellers from images. Lightweight model (279,577 parameters) achieved 95% test accuracy on 7,348 real industrial images. Applicable to Industry 4.0 automated quality inspection.
